note: Shinhan Bank's product explanation for its SOL-pyeonhan demand deposit account (the edition it hosts, reviewed for 12 October 2024 to 11 October 2025): it names no fee for keeping the account, and waives transfer fees to other banks, its own ATMs' withdrawal fees and automatic-transfer fees; only a passbook reissue is charged, not modelled. Read again 2026-10-30 (the product explanation is the edition reviewed for 12 October 2024 to 11 October 2025, still the one linked): open to individuals from 14, through the SOL app; the ordinary deposit pays 0.1% a year (as of 12 October 2024, before tax; the bank applies the rate posted daily); transfers to other banks by mobile, internet or phone banking and withdrawals at Shinhan machines are free. Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, another bank's machine, abroad, the card's share on another currency, the papers asked.
